title: Exam 2
subtitle: Pediatric Cardiovascular, Hematologic, GI, GU & Neurologic Alterations

practiceExams.note: The study guide lists 45 topic points plus 5 dosage calculations (3 alternate format), so each practice exam is 50 questions weighted exactly like the study guide. The guide gives no time limit; 51 minutes keeps the same pace as the program's other exams.

objectives.title: Cardiovascular Function & Perfusion
items: Examine the anatomy, physiology, pathophysiology, and screening of pediatric clients with alterations in cardiovascular function and perfusion
Explore etiology, epidemiology, risk factors, clinical presentation, diagnosis, and treatment of alterations in cardiovascular function and perfusion in pediatric clients
Describe the effect of alterations in cardiovascular function and perfusion on pediatric clients' overall health
Explore the role of the nurse when caring for pediatric clients with alterations in cardiovascular function and perfusion
Apply the nursing process using clinical judgment while caring for pediatric clients with alterations in cardiovascular function and perfusion
